title: A Transformer-Based Pavement Crack Segmentation Model with Local Perception and Auxiliary Convolution Layers
mechanism: Mask2Former plus a local perception module and auxiliary convolution layers to keep thin crack features that fade in the transformer path.
evidence: R: abstract only; numbers not retrieved (MDPI 403).
adaptation: Supports the full-res conv refinement head proposed for EoMT/M2F; local conv branch fed from the stem at full res for 1-2 px EL cracks.
min_experiment: Folded into the EoMT/M2F runs: refinement head on vs off; metric crack IoU and relF1@2; kill if gain < 0.012 crack IoU.
